bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: 26,000 followers. Eight seats.
beats.text: You have 26,200 Instagram followers, 1,724 YouTube videos and a mastermind for a maximum of eight women at $45,000. Every seat matters, and the price is right there on the page.

beats.title: Your content is already talking to applicants.
beats.text: Your “Take the Leap” series, the Italy retreat video and posts like “My clients already know I will never tell them what to do” speak straight to the woman who'd apply.

beats.title: After applying, there's no next step.
beats.text: Your Leap Year application ends on Tally's default “Thanks for completing this form!”, and every call depends on you reaching out yourself. While you travel and move, a ready applicant just waits.

beats.title: “I don't do sales calls.” This isn't one.
beats.text: Your price stays on the page. The call becomes a 30-minute fit conversation the applicant books herself, with a confirmation page and a few emails so she shows up prepared. No pressure, just fewer gaps.
beats.source: Olivia on oliviatati.com/leapyear, about pushy sales calls

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

Before we talk:
1. Keep the time free.
2. Write down the one leap you want to take in the next 12 months.

One note: nobody on my team will ever ask you to pay through a DM. Payments only happen through the official links from this email address.

Talk soon,
Olivia

preCallEmails.subject: Capacity, not burnout
preCallEmails.previewText: Why a plan beats one more tip
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Most of the women I work with aren't missing ambition. They're running their business with habits they brought from corporate.

That's where we start.

On the call we'll look at where you are today.

Olivia

preCallEmails.subject: "I've done programmes before"
preCallEmails.previewText: Then this is the next step
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

So have most of the women in the circle.

The difference is twelve months, eight women and me, with time together in person. It's built for living the change, not learning about it.

If you're not sure you need it, ask on the call. We'll tell you honestly.

Olivia

preCallEmails.subject: What we'll cover on the call
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

The call takes about 30 minutes:

1. Where you are now and what you've tried.
2. Where you want to be in a year.
3. How the program works, what it costs, and whether it fits you.

If it isn't a fit, we'll tell you. No pressure either way.

Olivia

preCallEmails.subject: Tomorrow: your call with Olivia's team
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Quick reminder: your call is tomorrow at {{call_time}}.

If the time doesn't work anymore, reschedule with the link in your invite so someone else can take the slot.

See you tomorrow,
Olivia

preCallEmails.subject: Today's the day
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is today at {{call_time}}. Find a quiet spot and have your questions ready.

Talk soon,
Olivia
